limits: Source review and two controlled probes only. No peer source edits, commits, pushes, public posts, Cargo/shared bank, real SSH/sudo/service/audio/device/network operations.
Original controller1 retained; subject0 transcripts transcribed from native output with explicit provenance, not a newly persisted raw terminal log. No subject rerun.
proposed_repair_gate: First rerun only two tiny stop-exit17 controls against the repaired actual functions/guard: no restore mutation or backup deletion, nonzero result, cleanup/restart still reached.

Then run an actual committed focused entry point covering empty-subtree copy refusal, save-cut, part-left, both/guard ordering, successful restore, prior digest/link refusals and both new stop-failure paths. Exact command must be supplied/committed, not an invented flag or ad-hoc sleep reduction.
Run applicable four source syntax checks, generated-restore sh-n and committed stand-in suite once.
Full original make-skill suite <=1200s is deferred until repair; consider it only if focused committed coverage cannot cover global save/trap/arm cleanup composition. No current full811 rerun.
remaining_source_review: Folder manifests now enumerate directories and regular files, record d/f entries plus entry count, and require both successful manifests to match. This addresses the earlier injected empty-subtree omission in source; current runtime repair closure not claimed while P2 remains.

Save writes into fresh0700 SAVED.part; final SAVED must be absent, both path kinds are recorded, manifests compared, done written, then part renamed. The stored script embeds final SAVED path. Main only proceeds to stand-in setup after successful save.

An interrupted save before rename leaves only part and does not authorize guard restore. The next preflight checks both existing final and part including symlinks, refuses before uploads/save, and prints explicit recovery. A late failure after rename retains final saved state because the failure cleanup removes only part. No simultaneous external-writer snapshot claim.

Per-arm reset remains unchanged with Voice running, as explicitly scoped. End-of-run and guard stop success are intended to be prerequisites, but the ignored-error P2 defeats that requirement. Main and guard must skip destructive restore on failed stop while continuing cleanup/restart and retaining nonzero failure status.

Existing focused controls only make stop succeed: local mock echoes stop, generated-guard mock records stop. Neither injects stop failure. No committed focused selector or executable entry point was found in the full test script.

No new broad writer race, real storage fault, physical restart/dependency or device-acceptance proof is supplied. System-unit claims and author811s/56 results remain separate source/producer evidence.
